explanation: The endpoints hybLaw 0 and hybLaw |W2| equal the XWE laws of false and true (ctLaw_congr: the bit function only matters below |W2|, via List.ext_getElem and getElem_mapIdx). Then telescope the advantage over the |W2| hops, apply Cauchy-Schwarz (sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq), and bound each hop gain by cost / 2^k.
